Also note logits row order: kernel uses logits as given but values are permuted by order! Wait — make_inputs returns logits and values[order]. The reference presumably computed on these returned tensors. The permutation is baked into the generator, so both kernel and reference see the same tensors — consistent. But did the kernel account? It just does softmax(logits)·values on the given tensors — matches reference on given tensors. Fine.

Main risk: quantization error exceeds 0.02. Record claim and probe.
